note: draft geometry measured from adapter artefacts; every field carries its method; hull_rings are floor/mid/roof

methods.barrel_length: RELATIVE: distance from GunPivot to Muzzle along the gun's own -Z in the measured model; relative basis identity: true. The adapter report's longer figure is deliberately NOT used: the model's muzzle is on the gun axis and agrees with the gun mesh's own extent
methods.gun_origin: RELATIVE: GunPivot relative to TurretPivot in the measured model
methods.hull_half_width: half of the hull mesh x-extent at mid height (same adaptive band as the mid ring)
methods.hull_rings: adaptive nearest-vertex band scan of the hull mesh: [y, half-width, front z, rear z]; ring 0 = floor, 1 = mid, 2 = roof; the effective y tolerance per ring is recorded in the notes
methods.mantlet_half_height: half of the mantlet mesh y-extent | FLOOR: raised to >= 1.3x the cited bore radius (0.0625 m) so the shield encloses the hole
methods.mantlet_half_width: maximum |x| of the mantlet/shield mesh vertices | FLOOR: raised to >= 1.6x the cited bore radius (0.0625 m) so the shield encloses the hole
methods.muzzle_brake: from the adapter artefact report (geometric tip check), see the note
methods.open_top: INFERRED: enclosed main battle tank, top band is closed; not a visual review
methods.ring_half: DERIVED: half of the smaller bottom-outline extent (no turret-ring node in this model), CLAMPED to 85% of the measured hull roof half-width (1.314 m) because a ring wider than the roof cannot produce manifold roof faces; author may replace
methods.track_width: largest wheel mesh x-extent (the belt width across the wheel)
methods.turret_bottom: minimum y of the turret mesh vertices
methods.turret_origin: RELATIVE: TurretPivot relative to the hull node in the measured model; relative basis identity: true
methods.turret_outline: convex outline of the turret mesh vertices in the BOTTOM quarter (ordered, x/z), de-duplicated at 5 mm so no two adjacent points coincide
methods.turret_taper: top-quarter half extent divided by bottom-quarter half extent
methods.turret_top: maximum y of the turret mesh vertices
methods.wheel_count: ROAD wheels on one side: wheel-named meshes with a numeric suffix, on x < 0, excluding return rollers (top_*), the front idler and the drive sprocket - the convention build_historical_packets.py uses
methods.wheel_radius: half of the largest wheel mesh y-extent

notes: hull mesh chosen for measurement: HullArmour
hull ring 0 used 6 nearest vertices, effective y tolerance 0.000 m
hull ring 1 used 6 nearest vertices, effective y tolerance 0.030 m
hull ring 2 used 6 nearest vertices, effective y tolerance 0.000 m
open_top is inferred, not visually verified
muzzle_brake is a geometric guess, not a documentary fact
adapter report barrel length 6.134 m was NOT used; the model's own muzzle distance 5.092 m is used instead
